name: Exterior Porch Ceiling RRP Lead-Safe Containment
intent: EPA RRP lead-safe protocol for pre-1978 homes. Lead screening, containment setup, wet scraping, HEPA vacuum, teardown. Overhead scraping is HIGH RISK for lead dust.
doctrine: RRP containment for porch ceiling. Conditional on pre_1978 + lead-positive. Overhead wet scraping very slow (50 SF/hr). 6-mil poly containment 10 ft from structure. HEPA vacuum all surfaces. RRP modifier (2.0x) applies to regular scrape/feather task in prep module.
